name: Insider One
description:
Insider MCP enables AI-powered clients to securely query Insider One CDP and APIs using natural language. It provides controlled, read-only access to Insider CDP and APIs, while fully respecting existing authentication, permission, and governance models.

Designed for enterprise use, Insider MCP allows teams to explore data, retrieve insights, and query platform objects without navigating dashboards or writing custom queries. All requests are permission-based, transparent, and executed through predefined APIs, ensuring security, control, and scalability as capabilities expand over time.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Insider One to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Insider One to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.insiderone.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Insider One MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Insider One provides these MCP tools: list_email_campaigns, get_email_campaign_analytics, and get_email_overall_analytics.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Insider One?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Insider One in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does Insider One MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Insider One requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Insider One is developed by Insider One. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
